dedupe_keys.name: financial stability oversight council annual reports and chart data

description: The Financial Stability Oversight Council annual report fulfils its mandate from Congress to report on the Council's activities, describe significant financial market and regulatory developments, analyse potential emerging threats to US financial stability, and make recommendations. They are produced by the Financial Stability Oversight Council and published on the website of the Department of the Treasury. Coverage is the US financial system. The 2025 report was the latest at access and is free as a PDF, with all charts as a PDF and the data behind the charts in Excel, and earlier reports are archived. Caveats: the chart workbooks include only data the Council has permission to publish from suppliers, so some series are missing, and the reports are assessments, not databases. For simulation they identify which emerging threats the Council considers most important for the financial system, helping to choose stress scenarios for resilience and cascading failure models. It is related to the Federal Reserve Financial Stability Report record in this catalogue.
